response.text: {"issues":["The homepage repeats the same message four times: hours note, booking section, cta band and contact section all say 'Naročite se po telefonu ali SMS' with the same sentence.","The hours note and the hero factNote both repeat 'Brez naročila samo, če je prost stol', and the hours section already shows the same sentence twice (note plus the facts note).","The booking section and the cta band are near duplicates and both sit just before the contact call-out, which already shows the phone number.","The team section is thin (one person, one sentence) and says what the about copy would."],"patches":[{"op":"remove","path":"/pages/0/sections/5"},{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/1/props/note","value":"Termin dobite po telefonu ali SMS."},{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/2/props/heading","value":"Termin poiščemo skupaj"},{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/2/props/text","value":"Pokličite ali nam pošljite SMS, pa vam poiščemo prost termin."}]}
